description: Update an existing ad set. Only provided fields will be modified.

adset_schedule.description: Hourly delivery intervals (Sunday=0). Requires lifetime budgeting. Set timezone_type explicitly; Meta defaults to USER.

attribution_spec.description: Attribution windows; Meta validates compatibility with the objective and optimization goal

bid_amount.description: New bid amount in currency cents

daily_budget.description: New daily budget in currency cents

destination_type.description: Conversion destination, e.g. WEBSITE, APP, MESSENGER, INSTAGRAM_DIRECT, WHATSAPP

dsa_payor.description: Payer of EU-targeted ads; does not automatically copy the beneficiary

lifetime_budget.description: New lifetime budget in currency cents

pacing_type.description: Pacing settings. When a schedule is supplied, day_parting is required and is added if omitted.

status.description: New status: ACTIVE, PAUSED, DELETED, ARCHIVED

targeting.description: New targeting spec as JSON string. Advantage+ Audience automation flags go inside this object, e.g. targeting_automation: {"advantage_audience":1} — required for HEC-F (Housing/Employment/Financial Products and Services) ad sets with relaxable, non-broad targeting as of v26.0. Note: the Instagram Explore Feed placement was removed in Marketing API v26.0 — requests that explicitly include it now return an error.

validate_only.description: Validate with Meta without creating or updating the ad set (default false)

name: update_adset
